prompt:

Primary request: create one polished 16:9 presentation slide for the process page.

Single claim: AI 客服是一条可治理的服务闭环
Audience: 产品负责人、客服运营、解决方案架构师与研发团队
Theme architecture: systems; spatial grammar = 在共享技术场中用节点、路径和显式分组建立空间关系; reading order = 先沿主要关系路径阅读，再查看次级分支和局部状态; density strategy = 每页只突出一个系统关系，次级分支保持稀疏并留出文字安全区; deck rhythm = 在全局概览、局部关系和安静判断页之间交替.

Visual scheme: systems/white-cyan-circuit/system-map; composition = one dominant hub with grouped surrounding capabilities and a legible primary relationship path; imagery = abstract nodes, thin directional connectors, restrained geometry; labels appear only when supplied by exact_text; requirements = relationship direction must be unambiguous; central node must remain visually dominant.
Title treatment: {"mode":"integrated","scale":"small-to-medium","placement":"top-left","weight":"conclusion integrated with the map"}; a page may use a medium conclusion, statement, caption or integrated text instead of an oversized title.
Frozen layout plan: text safe zone = top-left; visual zone = center, right; hierarchy = headline, system-groups, relationship-paths; density = medium.
Scene and visual brief: A restrained visual metaphor that supports the slide claim without adding factual detail
Text (verbatim; render every line exactly once, with correct Chinese characters and punctuation):
1. "AI 客服是一条可治理的服务闭环"
2. "统一接入"
3. "智能编排"
4. "知识与工具"
5. "模型服务"
6. "人工协同"
7. "运营治理"
Evidence constraints (do not turn evidence into extra visible labels unless it is also in exact_text): []
Typography: use the specified Chinese type pairing and a readable hierarchy; keep line breaks intentional; do not force every page into a giant headline and do not shrink text to fit.
Text safety: deep blue-gray text on white or pale blue with no signal line, node or highlight behind letters; no face, object, highlight, grid, or light path may pass behind the letters.
Information boundary: use only the supplied visible text; do not invent metrics, labels, citations, UI, logos, product screens, names, dates, or claims.
Constraints: render the complete slide as one finished image; preserve a clear visual hierarchy; keep generous margins; use one dominant visual anchor; no editable UI; no watermark; no logo.
Avoid: serial pipeline when relationships are parallel; unlabeled pseudo-metrics; dark cyberpunk stage; decorative pseudo-data; dense circuit-board wallpaper; glossy dashboard cards; oversized title on every page; extra words; misspelled Chinese; gibberish; tiny labels; dense card grids; busy detail behind text; decorative pseudo-data.
Continuity anchor: connection-node; continuity group: cover.
